description: This file contains instrumentation functions for integrating OpenTelemetry tracing into various web frameworks, HTTP libraries, and databases. It defines methods to instrument FastAPI, Flask, Requests, HTTPX, SQLAlchemy, SQLite3, Redis, and OpenAI API calls, primarily for monitoring and observability purposes.

classes.name: InstrumentedClient
classes.description: Custom HTTPX client class that wraps the send method for instrumentation.

classes.name: InstrumentedAsyncClient
classes.description: Custom asynchronous HTTPX client class that wraps the send method for instrumentation.

methods.name: _decode_body
methods.description: Decodes a request or response body to UTF-8 string if it's in bytes.

methods.name: _instrument_fastapi
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for FastAPI framework.

methods.name: _instrument_requests
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for requests library.

methods.name: _instrument_httpx
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for httpx library, including custom client classes.

methods.name: _instrument_flask
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Flask framework.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlalchemy
methods.description: Instruments SQLAlchemy to trace database queries, including capturing query results for SELECT statements.

methods.name: _instrument_dbapi
methods.description: Placeholder for database API instrumentation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlite3
methods.description: Placeholder for SQLite3 instrumentation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: _instrument_redis
methods.description: Instruments Redis client for tracing Redis commands and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_openai
methods.description: Placeholder for OpenAI API instrumentation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: apply_instrumentation
methods.description: Main function to apply all available instrumentations for frameworks, HTTP libraries, and databases.
